case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

response.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
response.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
response.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have reviewed your counter-offer and verified the updated volume forecast, which allows us to adjust our pricing accordingly. 

Our offer is a price of €371.07 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that extending the payment terms to 60 days would necessitate a higher unit price to cover the associated capital costs. 

As an alternative, at our standard terms, we offer a price of €369.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. To provide you with the most favourable commercial conditions, we propose to maintain the 30-day payment terms at a revised price of EUR 369.02. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: We refer to our standard Zahlungsziel, which is 30 days net.
